confidence_notes: Food estimates use current price indexes as proxies, not July-specific observations. Accommodation values are holistic estimates, with uncertain registered hostel and three-star supply. Alcohol is limited in Hampi village; drink estimates assume licensed venues in the wider Hampi–Hospet area. Cocktail and wine prices are inferred from their expected relationship to beer. Food references: [Hampi price index](https://hikersbay.com/prices/india/hampi?lang=en) and [Hospet price index](https://citycost.org/hospet/).
comparable_city_reasoning: Hampi's tourist economy and nearby Hospet provide the regional basis; Hospet is a proxy for mid-range dining and licensed bars. July's monsoon season informs the accommodation estimates.
